column1: # EZ LYNK custom configuration - GM E41 L5P - HP Tuners SOTF OS 69709844 - cal E2015G5141011_P2B
# Addresses are byte offsets in the exported SOTF .bin. ECU CPU addresses are given in DESC. All data is big-endian (MSB).
# Section A - Park/Neutral pedal torque table (KtDTRC_M_EngTrqReqForRPM) shown in lb-ft.
# Section B - HP Tuners SOTF switch positions 1 to 5: VGT feed-forward / VGT max limit / boost set-point at Lo / Mid / Sea baro (45 tables).
# Position 0 (switch off) uses the base calibration tables - not included here.
# VGT % : higher = vanes more closed (more boost and drive pressure). Boost set-point is ABSOLUTE pressure in kPa.
# Section B axes are read-only MANUAL axes (shared by all positions in the binary - edit them only in the base tune tool).

# Layout: X axis = across the top (RPM) and Y axis = down the side (pedal % or load). Check: Park/Neutral table - the 100% pedal row (bottom) reads 1408.6 563.3 328.6 211.1 140.7 93.9 60.3 26.4 2.2 left to right (stock).

column3: Use Rolling-Neutral Pedal Maps at Standstill (Base Progression Only)
column4: KeDTRC_b_UseBaseProgOnly. 1 = bypass the Park/Neutral (Neutral Control) table and launch assist so the normal pedal maps are used at every speed - standstill then uses the same driver-demand path as rolling in neutral. Also changes in-gear launches from a stop. Stock 0. ECU address 0x7A72C.

column3: Pedal Maps Use Road Speed (Fixed n/v Ratio)
column4: KeDTRC_b_EnblRPM_PedProg. 1 = pedal maps are looked up with road speed x the n/v ratio instead of engine RPM (your tuner set 1; stock 0). ECU address 0x7A729.
KeDTRC_r_VTS_NV_Ratio. Ratio that turns road speed into the pedal-map lookup value when road-speed lookup is on. ECU address 0x7A738.

column3: EGR-Open Vane Maps - Switch-On EGR Position
column4: KeAICC_Pct_VGT_FdFwdEGR_PstnOn (CPU 0x9A6B8). When measured EGR valve position goes ABOVE this the ECU stops using the per-tune VGT feed-forward and VGT max tables and uses the shared EGR-open tables (FdFwdEGR / MaxEGR) in every tune. Stock 3. Set 250 so it never happens and every tune keeps its own vane maps.

column3: EGR-Open Vane Maps - Switch-Off EGR Position
column4: KeAICC_Pct_VGT_FdFwdEGR_PstnOff (CPU 0x9A6B4). When measured EGR valve position drops BELOW this the ECU goes back to the per-tune vane tables. Must be lower than the switch-on value. Stock 1. Set 240 with switch-on 250.
